title: Area from width and height
prompt: Return the area of a rectangle from its two sides.
signature: func solve(width: int, height: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(width: int, height: int) -> int:
	return 0
hint: Area is one side multiplied by the other.
solution:
func solve(width: int, height: int) -> int:
	return width * height
